```{r}
#| label: packages
# Packages used should be installed before loading
library("tidyverse")
library("readxl")
```

```{r}
#| label: getting-data
# Pulls the data from the online source into _raw/

## Creating directories if they don't exist
raw_dir <- "../data/_raw/"

if( !dir.exists("../data/") ){
  dir.create(path = "../data/")}

if( !dir.exists(raw_dir) ){
  dir.create(path = raw_dir)}

## Defining what files to be extracted from zenodo
files <- tibble(
  name = c("tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 1.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 2.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 3.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 4.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 5.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 6.xlsx"),
  url  = str_c("https://zenodo.org/records/4936221/files/",
               URLencode(name), "?download=1")
)

## The function that extracts each file and clean the name (to not have spaces)
## Will not rerun if the files already exist
get_file <- function(name, url) {
  clean_name <- str_replace_all(name, " ", "_")
  dest <- str_c(raw_dir, clean_name)
  if (!file.exists(dest) || file.size(dest) < 10000) {
    download.file(url, destfile = dest, mode = "wb")
  }
  dest
}

## Running the download
paths <- map2_chr(files$name, files$url, get_file)
```
